MedlinePlus Consumer Guide: Managing Tension Headaches | Publisher: US National Library of
Ergonomics & Screen-Time Management
Preventing strain-induced headaches during work: - Position computer
screens at eye level 20-24 inches away. - Follow the 20-20-20 rule: Every
20 minutes, look at an object 20 feet away for 20 seconds.
